audio.strategy: One original piano-like additive synthesis voice, rendered into generated mono buffers at note onset and played through Web Audio. No recorded samples and no network audio assets.

generatedSources.name: Basic additive piano
generatedSources.license: Original implementation; generated waveform code and output released under MIT (LICENSE). No third-party recordings.
generatedSources.rootNotes: Generated at the exact incoming MIDI pitch, rather than transposed from a recorded root.
generatedSources.method: Six additive partials with slight inharmonicity, harmonic-dependent exponential decay, a 4 ms attack and 60 ms buffer-tail fade; partials above 45% of sample rate omitted. Up to 16 note buffers cached.

audio.signalPath: Generated AudioBufferSource -> per-voice velocity/release GainNode -> fixed 0.32 master GainNode -> AudioContext destination
audio.stealing: Oldest released voice first, then oldest sustained voice, then oldest held voice. Ownership uses input source and instance tokens.
audio.status: Idle before user input; loading during audio activation; ready only after a running AudioContext; error and retry if activation fails. Synthesis is the primary source, not a recording or an undisclosed fallback. No sample loading or sample fallback is claimed.
notes: Piano timbre is an approximation, not the Nord Piano Library or a recorded acoustic piano.
Held/sustained notes decay naturally and end after eight seconds. Sustain postpones the damper release; it does not loop the waveform.
UI sustain, keyboard Space and per-device/channel MIDI CC64 are combined independently.
All panel controls including Master Level are presentation-only. The audio master is fixed at 0.32.

Browser OfflineAudioContext tests render this actual audio graph and verify non-silence, continuous velocity response, release and sustain duration. Fake boundaries separately verify deterministic ownership and node/listener cleanup.

hardware.action: Hammer action (hardware variant designation; browser keys are pointer/keyboard inputs)
hardware.presentationState: Normalized ID-to-number model, isolated from the PianoEngine.
hardware.geometryPrecedence: Visual spec v1.4 and photo override the obsolete fractions in the phase prompt.
hardware.narrowInspection: Full instrument overview at 94% width; Inspect surface enlarges to 1400px in an independently scrollable viewport.

boundaries.audio: AudioBoundary injected into PianoEngine; AudioContext factory injected into BrowserAudio.
boundaries.midi: RequestMidi and MidiAccess interfaces injected into InputController.
boundaries.events: Window target injected into InputController.attach; pure input methods available for device-free tests.
boundaries.timing: AudioContext currentTime through the injected context; no application timers.
boundaries.storage: No storage reads or writes; all state is in memory.

unsupported: All panel audio and system behavior, including Master Level, wheels, Organ, Synth, Piano selectors/details, Layer Effects, Programs, scenes, morphs, split, transpose and panel Shift.
Multiple piano models, recorded samples, layering, audible effects, soft/sostenuto/half-pedal and pedal noise.
Aftertouch, Extern/Aux KB/MIDI menus, preset library, sample downloads and Nord hardware integration.

evidence.captureHarness: Workspace-local reproduction of the parent capture module read in this session; see tests/parent-harness/PROVENANCE.md. No external workspace reads are required to run it.
